top_stories.title: TurboMamba: Faster Inference, Faster Training, and Better Prediction with Lexical Memory
top_stories.description: arXiv:2610.20682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce TurboMamba, a language-model architecture for faster inference, faster training, and better token prediction. A global Mamba-3 model runs once per completed token block. A small Transformer uses this global context and earlier tokens within the block to predict the next token. top_stories.title: Could AI ‘change the stakes’ in the development of bioweapons?
top_stories.description: Experts say the technology could help terrorists and nation states with production but that significant hurdles remainIn his annual speech on threats to the nation, Sir Ken McCallum, the head of the UK’s intelligence service, MI5, warned that AI had the potential to “change the stakes” on existing and even new bioweapons. Here we look at how AI might help in the development of bioweapons and the hurdles that remain. Continue reading...
